definitions.explanation: A count of seven people, using the Sino-Japanese number with the counter {人|にん}. Also read ななにん, which is now more common in speech.

examples.japanese: {七人|しちにん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{班|はん}→班：03697_han⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{七人|しちにん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦メンバー→メンバー：00275_menbaa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{構成|こうせい}→構成：02729_kousei⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This group is made up of seven members.

examples.japanese: {黒澤|くろさわ}⟦{監督|かんとく}→監督：00185_kantoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧『{七人|しちにん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{侍|さむらい}→侍：10499_samurai⟧』⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{世界中|せかいじゅう}→世界中：10171_sekaijuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}えた→与える：01821_ataeru⟧。
examples.english: Director Kurosawa's Seven Samurai influenced films around the world.

notes:
{七|しち} plus the counter ⟦{人|にん}→〜人：00658_nin⟧ for people.

WHICH READING:
Both しちにん and ななにん are correct. ななにん is preferred in speech because しち is easily misheard as ⟦{一|いち}→一：00705_ichi⟧, but fixed titles and set phrases keep しち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ん.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {七人|しちにん}で: as a group of seven
- {七人|しちにん}⟦{兄弟|きょうだい}→兄弟：00964_kyoudai⟧: seven siblings
- {七人|しちにん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{侍|さむらい}→侍：10499_samurai⟧: Seven Samurai (the 1954 film)
